description: This file defines an API client that uses the fetch API to communicate with a backend service, incorporating JWT token forwarding logic via a getToken function. The client provides methods for GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE HTTP requests, with URL construction and response handling.

methods.name: createApiClient(getTokenFn)
methods.description: Creates and returns an API client object with methods for HTTP requests, injecting the JWT access token into headers and handling responses.
